qco.title: Electrical Appliances and Equipment (Quality Control) Order, 2020
qco.scope: Mandatory BIS certification for household electrical appliances covered under IS 302 before they are manufactured, stored for sale, sold, or distributed in India under Ministry of Commerce and Industry Gazette Order.
exemptions: Appliances manufactured exclusively for export are exempt from this Order.
requirements: Valid BIS Licence (ISI mark) under IS 302 before manufacture, sale, or import.
Registration and testing at a BIS-recognised laboratory against general and specific safety requirements.
Display of the Standard Mark on every unit placed in the market.
